lead.zh: 这篇哥伦比亚学生访谈呈现格林伯格怎样把集中投资、企业研究和管理人判断连接起来。原刊存档同时包含其他人的采访，不能整本混读。
lead.en: This Columbia student interview connects Greenberg’s concentration, business research and management assessment. The archived issue also contains other investors’ interviews.

heading.zh: 集中是研究安排的结果

paragraphs.zh: 他解释创办机构时希望把时间留给研究，并让自身及家人的资金与客户持有相同投资。
paragraphs.en: He describes prioritising research time and investing his own and family capital alongside clients.

heading.zh: 风险来自经营轨迹恶化
heading.en: Risk as deterioration in the business

paragraphs.zh: 他把风险与企业长期经营路径明显转差联系起来。因此，理解企业的竞争条件比单看股价波动更有用。
paragraphs.en: He relates risk to a business trajectory worsening materially, making competitive conditions more informative than price movements alone.

heading.zh: 管理人怎样面对坏消息

paragraphs.zh: 他重视管理层是否坦诚讨论经营问题，并举出低成本与行业规模优势等不同的企业模型。
paragraphs.en: He values candid discussion of business problems and examines models based on cost advantages and industry scale.

questions.zh: 阅读问题：在企业最近的公开沟通中，管理人明确承认过哪一项不利变化？
questions.en: Reading question: What adverse development has management explicitly acknowledged in its latest public communication?
